run_gen_install_table: run the script to generate an HTML table of detectron2 pip install commands for CUDA and PyTorch versions
run_gen_install_table_with_version: run the script with --d2-version flag to generate install commands pinned to a specific detectron2 version
gen_header_function: generate an HTML table header row with columns for each PyTorch version using the gen_header function
cuda_suffix_mapping: map CUDA version strings like 11.3 to their suffix format cu113 using the CUDA_SUFFIX dictionary
install_template: generate a pip install command snippet for detectron2 with a specific CUDA and PyTorch version using the template string
